summary: Quill Group is a Southport (Gold Coast) accounting, tax, advisory and financial planning firm serving family businesses and families, with offices across South East Queensland. Managing Director Eric Nicol has spent his whole finance career at Quill and won a Tech Innovator award in the Accountants Daily 30 Under 30 awards. The firm's advisers act as virtual CFOs and also manage clients' bookkeeping and payroll.

first.subject: Reconciliation behind Quill's virtual CFO work
first.body:
Hi Eric,

I saw you won the Tech Innovator award in the Accountants Daily 30 Under 30 awards and that Quill's advisors act as virtual CFOs for family businesses. Tech-minded firms often hit the same wall: bank reconciliation still eats the hours before any advice is given. I built Vert to turn hours of manual reconciliation into minutes, with an audit trail on every match. Where does reconciling sit in your team's workflow today?

Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech

followUp.subject: Re: Reconciliation behind Quill's virtual CFO work
followUp.body:
Hi Eric,

Following up on my last note. Quill's accounting team will take on a client's business accounting role, including bookkeeping and payroll. When that work sits with an account manager, how is the reconciling checked before it reaches the client? Happy to show Vert in a ten minute walkthrough, and I'd value your view as someone who has spent his whole career at Quill and won a tech award.

Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech

followUp2.subject: Re: Reconciliation behind Quill's virtual CFO work
followUp2.body:
Hi Eric,

Last note from me. With half of Quill's people there for over five years, I'd guess your processes are well worn. Vert is built to slot into that rather than replace it, and I'd value a tech award winner's honest critique. Ten minutes this week?

Best,
